title: Ignite! The Fire of Promises and Passion!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Waking up unusually early with nothing to do, I decided to head into Tracen Academy ahead of schedule—however...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aargh!! If it isn't the distracted-walking Trainer from the other day!!
Are you free right now, by any chance?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, would you please watch my morning practice?!
I know it's super sudden, but pretty please!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the persistent pleading of Bamboo Memory, who had apparently been training on her own since dawn, I ended up supervising her session.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOO!! Hot-Blooded Training of Passion!!
Number Five!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Break your limits!! Explosive Squats!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
DEYAAAH!! Hot-Blooded Training of Passion!!
Number Ten!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Bounce, muscles, bounce!! Galactica High Knees!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
DORYAAA!! Hot-Blooded Training of Passion!!
Number Fifteen—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I'm glad you asked!! My basic routine was actually put together by my dad back in the day!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And that is... the 'Hot-Blooded Training of Passion'!!
What do you think?! Cool name, right?!
choice_data_list: Was your dad a trainer or something?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no! My dad's a kendo master.
He teaches elementary school nowadays, so he isn't an expert on running or anything!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: When I was little, I was pretty frail and a huge crybaby on top of that. But Dad trained me up real good anyway.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: He studied stuff way outside his field and kept me company day in, day out. I loved my dad so much for that. I always looked up to him—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: —And there, I crossed paths once more with my former rival. It was the finals of the National Championship!!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: A-And then?! What happened next?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
That was when the shinai of our promise shone brilliantly—ah, too bad, break time is over!!
Hot-Blooded Training, second half: begin!!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Hot-Blooded Training of Passion, number ten... done!
Haaah... haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: Mm! You held back your urge to hear the rest of the story and pushed through! That patience is part of the training too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: If you keep putting in the effort step by step—without fail, you will stand on a battlefield of fierce passion just like mine!!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! I'll be patient and take it step by step!!
'Cause I'm gonna grow up big and strong just like you, Dad!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I wanted to experience those fiery battles from Dad's heroic tales for myself—to share that bond of rivalry and test my limits against someone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's why... I came to Tracen Academy! To clash in high-spirited showdowns with the ultimate rival!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!! And right now—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gah, look at the time!!
Sorry, Trainer, gotta get back to training!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By the time Bamboo Memory wrapped up her foundational menu, the sun had fully risen, and other horsegirls were starting to filter onto the track for morning practice.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Next up, I'd really love for you to see me run on the turf...! What do you say, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?! H-How did you know that?!
choice_data_list: Sorry, I saw you talking with the instructor yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory likely had plenty of aptitude for turf. Even if she aimed to switch over from dirt, there was no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So why was she so fixated on entering the upcoming Division Meet? I explained that I just couldn't understand why.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aah, I gotcha! Don't worry, the reason's real simple! It's because—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A gust of wind seemed to tear right past Bamboo Memory's back as she spoke.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just on the other side of the fence from our dirt track, charging across the lush green turf, was—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Oguri-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if pursuing Oguri Cap on the turf, Bamboo Memory took off sprinting along the adjacent dirt track.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah... ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, dirt made it harder to build speed compared to turf. The gap between them widened instantly. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Like I'd... ever give up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're my... rival!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even as she was left behind, Bamboo Memory never stopped. She pushed all the way through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, my bad for taking off out of nowhere! Truth is, senpai over there is—
choice_data_list: The reason you want to run on turf?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, you figured it out?! Isn't she incredible?! Isn't she fast?! That's Oguri Cap-senpai for you!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The first time I saw her run, it hit me like a lightning bolt! I just knew—this person is my rival!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...It's gotta be destiny.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I wanna fight her! I wanna catch up to her! I want to run on the exact same course as her right now!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's why I gotta switch to turf! Oguri-senpai's entering the 1600m Turf at the Division Meet, so I have to be there too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My instructor's worried about my hooves, so she recommended dirt. I trust her judgment, and I've been following her advice, but...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —I still want to fight! This burning feeling won't let up! I mean, I've already met her, so how could I stop now?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In that moment, I understood that nothing could hold her back. Though she appeared to be taking things one step at a time, her heart was already sprinting at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I wanted to see the scenery she was chasing after, alongside her. And right now, I couldn't stop that feeling within myself either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because I had already met Bamboo Memory.
